details: CONFIRMED. The queue item promises "doctor flags a project whose AGENTS.md is neither imported nor loaded by the claude-md-and-agents-md setting". claude-md-and-agents-md is a VALUE, not a key: the installed binary defines `instructionFiles:{type:"string",title:"Project instructions",description:"claude-md ... claude-md-or-agents-md (default) ... claude-md-and-agents-md: AGENTS.md files are loaded beside CLAUDE.md ..."}` and an alias map {none:"managed-only",claude:"claude-md","agents-fallback":"claude-md-or-agents-md",both:"claude-md-and-agents-md"}. It is a plugin option ("by its instructionFiles option"); plugin options are read from settings.pluginConfigs[...].options ("no pluginConfigs[...].options in user, --settings or man..."), so a project .claude/settings.json may not be where it lives at all. The code reads `read_json(.claude/settings*.json).get("claude-md-and-agents-md")`: wrong key and possibly wrong file. No test covers the settings branch, which is how it slipped. Size: 15 (read the option where Claude Code reads it, or drop the settings branch and say so in the doctor message; add tests 1-3).
evidence: probe (scratch folder, AGENTS.md present, CLAUDE.md "# x\n"):
AGENTS.md as project instructions: ... by its instructionFiles option, loaded beside CLAUDE.md, left out, ...
failing_case: Project with AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md without an import, and the setting the queue item names set the way Claude Code reads it: instructionFiles = "claude-md-and-agents-md" (an option of Claude Code's built-in AGENTS.md plugin; 2.1.314 reads plugin options from pluginConfigs[<plugin>].options in user, --settings or managed settings).
Now: agents_md_loaded -> False, doctor prints "AGENTS.md is loaded" as failed and tells the owner to add @AGENTS.md, although Claude Code does load AGENTS.md beside CLAUDE.md.
Reverse: .claude/settings.json {"claude-md-and-agents-md": true} -> doctor green, yet Claude Code ignores that key and skips AGENTS.md.
Should: doctor passes only when the real option is on (value "claude-md-and-agents-md" or its alias "both"), and a key Claude Code does not read does not count.
fix_hint: Read the option where Claude Code stores it: pluginConfigs[<the built-in AGENTS.md plugin>].options.instructionFiles in ~/.claude/settings.json (and project settings only if Claude Code reads it there), accepting "claude-md-and-agents-md" or "both". If that place cannot be pinned down cheaply, drop the settings branch: the import is the one fix doctor recommends anyway.
pass_cases: 1. AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md "# x" + the instructionFiles option set to "claude-md-and-agents-md" where Claude Code reads it -> check passes.
3. AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md "# x" + .claude/settings.json {"claude-md-and-agents-md": true} -> check fails.
4. AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md "@AGENTS.md\n# x", no setting -> passes (works today).

details: CONFIRMED by probe. Claude Code's @path import works anywhere in the text, with relative paths (./), and .claude/CLAUDE.md is a project memory file it loads (its list: CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, .claude/AGENTS.md). A team that already imports AGENTS.md its own way gets a false red doctor line with advice that does not apply. The brief cites arsenal's CLAUDE.md:3 as the model; whatever its exact form, any form other than the bare line fails. Size: 15.
failing_case: Project with AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md "@./AGENTS.md\n# x" (or "Team rules: @AGENTS.md", or the import in .claude/CLAUDE.md, which Claude Code also loads). Claude Code imports AGENTS.md in each case.
Now: agents_md_loaded -> False; doctor fails the check and tells the owner to add a line it already has.
fix_hint: Match an import token, not a whole line: re.search(r"(^|\s)@(\./)?AGENTS\.md\b", text, re.M) over CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md (code fences can be ignored for this check).
pass_cases: 3. .claude/CLAUDE.md "@../AGENTS.md" (or "@AGENTS.md" relative to the project, as Claude Code resolves it), root CLAUDE.md without import -> passes.
findings.summary: doctor sees an import only as the exact line @AGENTS.md in the root CLAUDE.md; @./AGENTS.md, an inline import, or one in .claude/CLAUDE.md is reported as AGENTS.md not loaded
